name: Muhammad Alfath Abibi
title: Software Engineer
summary: Full Stack Engineer crafting enterprise & government systems across Indonesia and Singapore. Building reliable, scalable software with modern tech stacks.
about: I'm a Full Stack Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia, with hands-on experience delivering enterprise and government systems across Indonesia and Singapore.
My journey spans from building national-scale platforms for transportation operations and health product regulation, to creating startup applications like ride-hailing and coaching platforms.

I'm passionate about writing clean, testable code and building systems that are both reliable and maintainable. Whether it's architecting backend services with .NET or Java Spring, crafting responsive UIs with Vue.js, or setting up cloud infrastructure on AWS — I bring a holistic approach to software delivery.
